messages:
Mia Chen: starting shadow run for model v2.3-int6-mix across 5k queries, slices: long-context, docs, code. goal=validate quality and latency tail before a 2-step promote.
Arjun Patel: nice — what's the canary window and traffic split?
Mia Chen: 1h window, 0% production (shadow only). If stats look good, staged promote: 5% for 30m then 20% for 1h.
Ben G.: quick flag note: kernel=auto-select, prefer_int6=true, per_layer_clip=true. Perf compiled with new fused-attention.
Sofia Morales: added smoke eval set (100 prompts) focusing on factuality + instruction-following. baseline is v2.2-fp16.
Mia Chen: putting target acceptance criteria here:
- delta_mean_ROUGE <= 0.03 on docs slice
- token_fidelity_drop <= 0.06 overall
- hallucination_spike <= 1.5x baseline on any slice
- p95 latency increase <= 15ms
- CI z-score <= 2.5 for quality diffs
Arjun Patel: autofallback thresholds we discussed: absolute delta > 0.08 OR z-score > 3 for any critical slice triggers immediate fallback. Also circuit-breaker if error_rate > 0.5% over 5m.
Ben G.: dashboard link (nightly): https://dash.redwood/experiment/1739456789 — metric panels are populated.
ops-bot: shadow run initialized: model=v2.3-int6-mix, run_id=sr-1739456789, QPS cap=150, sample_size=5000.
Mia Chen: early read at 15m: docs_slice ROUGE delta=0.025 (ok), code_slice ROUGE delta=0.07 (worry), p95 latency +12ms.
Sofia Morales: code slice regression might be due to per-layer_clip; can we rerun an isolated batch without per_layer_clip?
Arjun Patel: I can run a short A/B shadow: same inputs, variant A=per_layer_clip on, B=clip off for code layers. Giving it 10m.
deploy-bot: ab-shadow job queued: job=ab-1739456789-1, samples=800.
Ben G.: also check tokenization edgecases — INT6 quant sometimes adds EOS jitter on code tokens. I saw token-repeat increase +0.6% in a small sample.
Mia Chen: good call. if token-repeat > 1% on any slice, we auto-fail. Add that to the acceptance set for this run.
Arjun Patel: short AB results in: A (clip on) code_ROUGE delta 0.075, token-repeat 0.9%. B (clip off) code_ROUGE delta 0.04, token-repeat 0.5%. latency similar.
Sofia Morales: B looks better for code. But we need to validate docs slice stability if clip off.
Mia Chen: decision: pause promote, spin up variant v2.3-int6-mix-clipoff for another shadow targeting docs+code. Keep same auto-fallback policy.
Ben G.: created config: ```
model: v2.3-int6-mix-clipoff
kernel: fused-attn-v3
quant: int6
per_layer_clip: false
```
ops-bot: shadow run initialized: model=v2.3-int6-mix-clipoff, run_id=sr-1739456790, sample_size=4500.
Mia Chen: note for postmortem if we hit rollback: capture prompt-level diffs and top-10 tokens causing divergence.
Arjun Patel: logging hooks added. will also export kv-cache hit rates — sometimes quant affects cache reuse.
Sofia Morales: timeline: rerun now, smoke eval in 45m, then reconvene for promote decision.
Mia Chen: thanks all. if auto-fallback triggers during any staged promote, ops-bot should cut traffic and revert to v2.2-fp16 automatically.
Ben G.: can we tweak circuit-breaker sensitivity? maybe require two consecutive 5m windows above threshold before full rollback to avoid flapping.
Mia Chen: yes — implement hysteresis: require 2 windows OR absolute error spike > 1%. I'll add that to rollout policy.
Sofia Morales: ping me with the final scorecard, I'll run a manual sanity on safety slices before we toggle any traffic. :eyes:
Mia Chen: noted. archiving logs to /mnt/experiments/1739456789 after run completes. will update thread with final numbers. :rocket:
